name: Flight results
summary: A list of flight options: departure and arrival times and airports, the duration over a stops line, the airline as a drawn mark, the price, Best and Cheapest tags, and sort chips.
use: on a flight search results page, for comparing and choosing a flight
a11y: Sort chips are toggle buttons with aria-pressed, and each flight is one link whose name reads the whole flight (times, airports, duration, stops, price and tag); the drawn marks are decorative.
